pidamos: pedir — let us ask (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative; = pidamos)
digamos: dezir — let us say (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative; digamos que 'let us say that'; = digamos)
llevaremos: levar — we shall carry, take (future 1st pl.; = llevaremos)
enseñar: enseñar — to show, point out (infinitive, old sense; first half of a split future, enseñar las hemos 'we shall show them'; = enseñar, closest mostrar)
heredadas: heredar — endowed with an inheritance, provided with lands (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with ellas; = heredadas)
retrayan: retraer — they may reproach, bring up against (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; ante que nos retrayan 'before they throw in our faces'; = retraigan)
levaremos: levar — we shall carry, take along (future 1st pl.; = llevaremos)
valen: valer — they are worth (present 3rd pl.; averes que valen grant valor 'goods of great worth'; = valen)
escarniremos: escarnir (escarnecer) — we shall mock, dishonour, humiliate (future 1st pl.; = escarneceremos, closest deshonraremos)
callar: callar — to fall silent, be silent (infinitive; fizo callar la cort 'he made the court fall silent'; = callar)
arras: arras — dower, bridal gift made by the bridegroom to the bride (fem. pl.; = arras)
diemos: dar — we gave (preterite 1st pl., old -ie- form; = dimos)
veran: ver — they will see (future 3rd pl.; = verán)
oviéremos: aver — we shall have (future subjunctive 1st pl.; los fijos que oviéremos 'the children we shall have'; = hubiéremos, now expressed by tengamos / tuviéremos)
avrán: aver — they will have (future 3rd pl.; = habrán)
partiçión: partiçión — division, share in an inheritance (fem.; aver partiçión 'to have a share'; = partición)
curiava: curiar — he guarded himself, took care, was concerned (imperfect 3rd sg., here with reflexive se run into non: nos curiava = non se curiava 'he did not trouble himself'; Pidal; = (se) curiaba, closest cuidaba)
diestes: dar — you gave (preterite 2nd pl., old -istes; = disteis)
quiéroles: querer + les — I wish (present 1st sg., with diphthong, + enclitic dative les 'to them'; = les quiero)
paños: paño — cloth, fabric, garment of cloth (masc. pl.; = paños)
çiclatones: çiclatón — ciclatón, a rich silk cloth, gold-worked or fine (masc. pl.; = ciclatones)
levades: levar — you carry off, take away (present 2nd pl., old -ades; = lleváis)
telas: tela — web, fabric; telas del coraçón 'heartstrings, the inmost heart' (fem. pl.; = telas)
servides: servir — you serve (present indicative 2nd pl., old -ides; si bien las servides 'if you serve them well'; = servís)
rendré: render — I shall give, pay back (future 1st sg., syncopated; vos rendré galardón 'I shall repay you'; = rendiré)
atorgado: atorgar — granted, agreed to (past part. masc. sg., with lo; atorgado lo han 'they have agreed to it'; = otorgado)
mandavan: mandar — they were ordering (imperfect 3rd pl.; = mandaban)
escurren: escurrir — they escort, accompany on departure (present 3rd pl.; Pidal 'acompañan al partir'; escurrir is not modern escurrir 'to drain')
cid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (restored in italics [Cid], printed without the cedilla; = Çid)
espidimiento: espidimiento — leave-taking, farewell (= despedida); en espidimiento son 'they are taking their leave'
pedimos: pedir — we ask (present 1st pl.; merçed vos pedimos 'we ask your favour'; = pedimos)
engendrastes: engendrar — you begot (preterite 2nd pl., old -astes; = engendrasteis)
parió: parir — she bore, gave birth to (preterite 3rd sg.; = parió)
enviades: enviar — you send (present 2nd pl., old -ades; = enviáis)
cunplir: cunplir — to fulfil, carry out (infinitive; debdo nos es a cunplir 'it is our duty to carry out'; = cumplir)
mandáredes: mandar — you may command, you shall command (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; lo que mandáredes 'whatever you command'; = mandareis, now expressed by mandéis / mandaréis)
abraçólas: abraçar + las — he embraced them (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic object las; = las abrazó)
saludólas: saludar + las — he greeted, took leave of them (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic object las; = las saludó)
doblava: doblar — she doubled, did likewise, repeated the act (imperfect 3rd sg.; la madre lo doblava 'the mother did the same'; = doblaba)
andad: andar — go, go on (imperative 2nd pl.; = andad, closest id)
bendixieron: bendezir — they blessed (strong preterite 3rd pl.; = bendijeron)
diéronles: dar + les — they gave them (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic dative les; = les dieron)
penssavan: pensar — they were thinking, were preparing (imperfect 3rd pl.; penssar de + inf. 'to set about'; = pensaban)
clara: clara — bright, illustrious (fem. sg.; Valencia la clara 'famed Valencia'; = clara)
avueros: agüero — omen, augury (masc. pl.; en los avueros 'in the omens', by observing omens; = agüeros)
tacha: tacha — flaw, blemish, fault (fem.; sin alguna tacha 'without any flaw'; = tacha)
repentir: repentir — to repent, regret (infinitive, here reflexive: nos puede repentir 'he cannot repent'; = arrepentirse)

__broaden__.darvos: dar + vos — to give you (infinitive + enclitic vos) · also darvos — dar + vos, first half of a split future 'I shall give you' (darvos he mis fijas 'I shall give you my daughters'; darvos [he] mulas; = os daré)
